knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the facility buys a checkable result inside a defined scope, with certainty such as a signed item list. Equipment, the hourly rate or the business age are not what the offer sells.
The lesson says a guarantee or fix-first promise must be something you can deliver and afford. Open-ended, impossible or limited-audience guarantees do not meet that test.
The lesson says a claim about a result needs evidence that supports it. An endorsement, a discount or no evidence does not meet that standard.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
